svg.title: CloudWatch metrics DSL support map
svg.desc: CloudWatch metrics helpers create scoped clients, build MetricDatum objects, publish single or multiple metrics, and list metrics by namespace and metric name filters.
svg.text: The aws-kotlin module wraps CloudWatchClient with scoped lifecycle, MetricDatum builders, publish helpers, and list filters.
CloudWatch metric helpers keep SDK-native suspend calls while metric construction, namespace validation, and list filters stay explicit.
